title: Run 2 — on the go (Jaipur, sangeet in 4 hours)

steps.text: just finished Amber Fort, sangeet is at 7 — what do I do with the afternoon?
On it, two lines: Jantar Mantar is 10 min away and open till 17:00, then Johari Bazaar for the Diwali gifts before the sangeet. Day Planner is routing.

data.note: re-planned from the Amber Fort gate — sangeet 19:00

steps.text: One direction, no backtracking. Afternoon line: ₹450 (tickets + 3 e-rickshaws). If you're running late: drop the City Palace, keep Johari — the gifts cannot move.
That's the afternoon. I'll ping you 40 minutes before the sangeet and 2 hours before tomorrow's train out. I don't nag — one ping, then I'm quiet.
